findings.statement: TNFa pathway activity is higher at baseline in non-responders to ustekinumab (t [type=response_pathway; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.ustekinumab.t_nr_vs_r=4.79]) and infliximab (BH padj [type=response_pathway; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.infliximab.padj=0.000294]), but it also separates UNIFI placebo non-responders (padj [type=response_pathway; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.placebo (UNIFI).padj=0.00608]), so it is associated with severity rather than a drug-specific mechanism; PURSUIT placebo shows nothing (padj [type=response_pathway; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.placebo (PURSUIT).padj=0.932]).

JAK-STAT activity is higher in ustekinumab non-responders (BH padj [type=response_pathway; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.ustekinumab.padj=0.0124]) but not significantly in golimumab (padj [type=response_pathway; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.golimumab.padj=0.204]); the vedolizumab, etrolizumab and ACT1 arms also do not survive correction.

OSM is higher at baseline in ustekinumab non-responders (BH padj [gene=OSM; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.ustekinumab.padj=0.0000264]) but not in golimumab (padj [gene=OSM; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.golimumab.padj=0.994]), and the drug-vs-placebo interaction is null (padj [gene=OSM; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; interaction.ustekinumab.padj=0.974]); UNIFI placebo is borderline (padj [gene=OSM; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.placebo (UNIFI).padj=0.116]), so this looks like a severity marker, not a mechanism tied to the IL12 and IL23 axis.

In the adalimumab single-cell atlas (GSE282122, small cohort) OSM shows no significant cell-state difference between remitters and non-remitters, so no cellular source of a baseline anti-TNF signal is supported.

TREM1 is higher in ustekinumab non-responders (BH padj [gene=TREM1; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.ustekinumab.padj=0.0000474]) but also in UNIFI placebo non-responders (padj [gene=TREM1; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.placebo (UNIFI).padj=0.0234]); this is associated with general severity, not a ustekinumab-specific mechanism, and golimumab and infliximab arms do not survive correction.

CXCL8 is higher in ustekinumab non-responders (BH padj [gene=CXCL8; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.ustekinumab.padj=0.000102]) and in UNIFI placebo non-responders (padj [gene=CXCL8; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.placebo (UNIFI).padj=0.0154]), consistent with a neutrophil-severity signal rather than drug-specific; the anti-TNF and vedolizumab arms are small and not significant.

CXCR2 is the top-ranked gene in the convergence ranking (six evidence streams, expression, replication, genetics, literature and tractability, with phase two to three antagonists of CXCR1 and CXCR2), but its baseline association with ustekinumab non-response (BH padj [gene=CXCR2; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.ustekinumab.padj=9.69e-6]) is mirrored in UNIFI placebo (padj [gene=CXCR2; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.placebo (UNIFI).padj=0.0126]) and absent in golimumab (padj [gene=CXCR2; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.golimumab.padj=0.994]), so it marks severity.

IL23A baseline expression is not associated with ustekinumab response (BH padj [gene=IL23A; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.ustekinumab.padj=0.977]); the drug target transcript carries no response signal in any arm.

CHRDL2 leads the discovery screen: stromal, replicated in Garrido-Trigo 2023, Gubatan 2026 and GSE282122 (inflammatory fibroblasts in Smillie 2019), antibody-tractable with no clinical drug, but only partly composition-independent (retained [gene=CHRDL2; type=discovery_profile; source=ANALYSIS:discovery; retained=0.276]) and with the highest vital-organ RNA of the set (nTPM [gene=CHRDL2; type=discovery_profile; source=ANALYSIS:discovery; vital_max_ntpm=42.6]); response data and genetics are missing.

CPXM1 is a stromal (inflammatory fibroblast) candidate replicated in Garrido-Trigo 2023 and GSE282122 (Gubatan 2026 calls epithelial), with the highest retained share among the stromal hits (retained [gene=CPXM1; type=discovery_profile; source=ANALYSIS:discovery; retained=0.414]), but only partly independent of cell composition and no functional or genetic support.

LAX1 is up in all eight cohorts with very low vital-organ RNA, but its T/NK lineage call does not replicate (Garrido-Trigo 2023 and Gubatan 2026 call plasma, only GSE282122 agrees) and most of the signal tracks cell composition (retained [gene=LAX1; type=discovery_profile; source=ANALYSIS:discovery; retained=0.230]), so it largely reflects lymphocyte infiltration.

GLT1D1 passes the novelty filter but is classed as composition: it is overwhelmingly neutrophil-derived (neutrophil share [gene=GLT1D1; type=discovery_profile; source=ANALYSIS:discovery; neutrophil_share=0.891]) with no retained tissue change, so it marks neutrophil infiltration rather than a change of the mucosa itself.

XKR9 is the only top-15 hit classed as intrinsic and epithelial (retained [gene=XKR9; type=discovery_profile; source=ANALYSIS:discovery; retained=0.798]), with epithelial lineage replicated in Gubatan 2026 and GSE282122 and low vital-organ RNA (nTPM [gene=XKR9; type=discovery_profile; source=ANALYSIS:discovery; vital_max_ntpm=3.1]); weaknesses are the fewest cohorts with increased expression among the shortlist, very low percent of expressing cells, and no response or genetic evidence.

caveats: Response associations come from baseline bulk expression with unbalanced arms (UNIFI has many more non-responders than responders; golimumab, infliximab and vedolizumab arms are small), so non-significant arms are low-power, not evidence of absence.
Most ustekinumab-associated genes also separate UNIFI placebo non-responders and have null drug-vs-placebo interactions, so they are severity markers; PURSUIT placebo has little power.
Convergence ranking scores are dominated by inflammation-driven expression; many top genes are neutrophil or myeloid and should be read with the composition filter.
Discovery candidates have no response, genetic or functional evidence in these tools; the anti-TNF single-cell cohort is small (six remitters).
Association only; no claim of prediction.
